queries: SELECT AVG(total_points), AVG(avg_laps) FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid >= 12 GROUP BY driverId)

SELECT AVG(total_points), AVG(avg_laps)
FROM (
  SELECT driverId,
         SUM(points) AS total_points,
         AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(laps, 'N'), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results
  GROUP BY driverId
);
